note: Hand-editable NHLPA 93 / NHL 94 patch -> General MIDI table (both games share the 32 FM patches and the PCM patch numbers). Chosen from measurements of each patch rendered through the retail drivers (data/audio/nhl9x-patch-analysis.json) and how the songs use it; not auditioned. Edit any target by ear; node test/nhl9x-gm-map.js checks it.

conventions.pitch: MIDI note = the stream note (the driver plays note 60 at about C4).
conventions.drum: Drum targets become channel-10 hits at that GM drum note.
conventions.patchIds: 0-31 are FM patches, 96-110 ($60-$6E) are PCM samples.

patches.character: Default patch (no song or sound effect selects it). 4-operator chain, no feedback.
patches.reason: Nothing plays it; Lead 1 (square) is a placeholder.

patches.character: Feedback 7 chain with a slow carrier attack (AR 19), long sustain. Lead and bass in the 94 title tunes, mid-range in the 93 title tune.
patches.reason: Fast attack, bright (centroid 4.6x), decays away: Clavinet. Measured at the probe note: slow decay, attack 15 ms, -15 dB at key off, centroid 4.6x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Two pairs, a high-ratio modulator (x12) on the first pair, both carriers decay to silence (SL 15). Mid-high melody in one 93 song.
patches.reason: Soft (1.4x), fast attack, slow decay: Electric Piano 1. Measured at the probe note: slow decay, attack 5 ms, -8 dB at key off, centroid 1.4x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Weak modulator (TL 64), fast decay to a low sustain. Mid-high parts in two 94 songs.
patches.reason: Mellow sustained tone with a fast attack: Clarinet. Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 15 ms, -2 dB at key off, centroid 1.5x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Algorithm 5, feedback 7, sustained (SL 0) with a moderate decay; the same family as patch 11 an octave higher in ratio.
patches.reason: Slow attack (75 ms), long release, sustained: Synth Strings 1. Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 75 ms, -2 dB at key off, centroid 2.5x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Serial chain at half ratio on every operator, feedback 6, flat sustain, fast release. Top notes (68-98) of one 94 song.
patches.reason: Swell (335 ms attack), bright, sustained, on the highest notes of a song: Synth Brass 2. Measured at the probe note: swell, attack 335 ms, 0 dB at key off, centroid 5.4x the note, flatness 0.02.

patches.character: Non-harmonic ratios (x14, x10), fast decay to a low sustain. Repeating figure on notes 59-67 in a 93 song.
patches.reason: Very bright (7x), fast attack, rings and fades: Tubular Bells. Measured at the probe note: slow decay, attack 5 ms, -8 dB at key off, centroid 7x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Algorithm 5, slow attack (AR 14-16), flat sustain, detuned operators. Mid notes in one 94 song.
patches.reason: Mellow (1.5x), fast attack, sustained: Flute. Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 30 ms, -2 dB at key off, centroid 1.5x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Serial chain, feedback 7, flat sustain, with LFO vibrato (FMS 1). Melody in a 93 and a 94 song.
patches.reason: Bright (5.3x), sustained, with LFO vibrato (FMS 1): Lead 2 (sawtooth). Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 20 ms, -4 dB at key off, centroid 5.3x the note, flatness 0.01.

patches.character: Algorithm 5, feedback 7, three carriers, flat sustain. The lead of 72 NHL 94 team tunes and of five 93 songs (notes 24-91).
patches.reason: 80 ms attack, bright (3.3x), sustained: Synth Brass 1. It is the lead of 72 NHL 94 team tunes and five 93 songs. Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 80 ms, -2 dB at key off, centroid 3.3x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: All operators at half ratio, decays to silence (SL 15, D1R 8). Bass (notes 39-53) of a 93 song.
patches.reason: Soft (1.4x), fast attack, decays: Electric Bass (finger). Measured at the probe note: slow decay, attack 5 ms, -6 dB at key off, centroid 1.4x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Metallic click (x13 modulator), carrier decays to a low level. Bass (notes 28-60) in 93/94 songs.
patches.reason: Plucked, fast attack, 25 dB down at key off: Electric Bass (pick). Measured at the probe note: plucked, attack 10 ms, -25 dB at key off, centroid 2.2x the note, flatness 0.

patches.character: Slow-attack second operator, LFO vibrato (FMS 3), carriers decay away. Notes 53-87 in a 94 song.
patches.reason: Slow attack (105 ms), mellow, sustained, LFO vibrato (FMS 3): Violin. Measured at the probe note: sustained, attack 105 ms, -2 dB at key off, centroid 1.7x the note, flatness 0.01.

patches.character: No feedback, TL 0 on every operator, quick decay. Always notes 37-40 in a 93 song.
patches.reason: A short low thump that keeps its pitch (notes 37-40 in the one NHL 93 song that uses it) and is the import target for toms: Low Floor Tom. Patch 20, not this one, is the kick the retail songs play on the beat. Measured at the probe note: plucked, attack 5 ms, -33 dB at key off, centroid 4.8x the note, flatness 0.02.

patches.character: Fixed-pitch deep thump (note 21): the kick of the 93/94 menu songs.
patches.reason: The kick of the 93/94 menu and title songs: always note 21 (a fixed deep thump), one hit about every beat, with the PCM big hit (patch 106) exactly between two of them in NHL 93 $37 and NHL 94 $7A (median phase 0.5, data/audio/nhl9x-dac-analysis.json kickSnarePairs): kick on the beat, snare on the backbeat. Bass Drum 1. Measured at the probe note: plucked, attack 15 ms, -42 dB at key off.

gmToNhl.note: GM -> NHL 93/94 import: exact matches come from the patch -> GM table above (a patch whose target is that GM program); otherwise the family patch. Drums become hits on one channel.

drums.name: Kick: the fixed-pitch FM thump the retail songs use (patch 20 at note 21)
Toms: the short pitched FM thump (patch 17)
Snare and claps: the big-hit PCM sample (patch 106 at note 76, as the retail songs play it)
Hi-hats and cymbals: the noise burst (patch 25)
